title: Ulyana and the Alibi
author: Emrys Eriksen
blurb: Tamsin Crane, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
